name: Pre-Built Contact Form 7 Templates – Formzard
author: Anwer Ashif

sections.description:
Formzard is the ultimate add-on for Contact Form 7, designed to streamline form creation with pre-designed templates. Instead of building forms from scratch, simply select a professionally crafted template and customize it to your needs.

Why Choose Formzard?

  • Save time with ready-made Contact Form 7 templates.
  • No coding required—just import, edit, and publish.
  • Optimized for mobile responsiveness and fast performance.

Key Features:

  • Contact Us Form – Name, email, subject, and message fields.
  • Event Registration Form – Collect attendee details easily.
  • Newsletter Signup Form – Build your email list effortlessly.
  • Job Application Form – Accept resumes and candidate info.
  • Survey Form – Gather user feedback with multiple-choice options.
  • Donation Form – Securely accept online donations.
  • Appointment Booking Form – Allow users to schedule appointments.
  • Feedback Form – Collect user reviews and testimonials.
  • Request a Quote Form – Let potential clients request estimates.
  • More templates added regularly!

Each template is built for seamless integration with Contact Form 7, ensuring an easy and hassle-free form-building experience.

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate Formzard.
  2. Go to Formzard in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Choose a template and import it instantly.
  4. Customize it with Contact Form 7 and publish.

Credits

Developed by Anwer Ashif to make Contact Form 7 more efficient and user-friendly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/formzard directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate Formzard from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Formzard in the WordPress admin panel to start using pre-built form templates.
sections.faq:
Do I need to install Contact Form 7?

Yes, Formzard is an addon for Contact Form 7 and requires it to function.

Can I edit the templates?

Yes! After importing, you can fully customize each template in Contact Form 7.

Are the templates mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! All templates are responsive and adapt to different screen sizes.

Can I add my own templates?

Currently, Formzard focuses on pre-designed templates, but you can create and manage forms manually within Contact Form 7.
